conventions.sparsity: Dense hardware peaks. MoE routing does not confer 2:4 hardware sparsity.
conventions.omissions: Dequantization, nonlinear functions, normalization, routing, recurrent updates/rollback, memory and launches need separate instruction or profile accounting. Displayed compute is a modeled arithmetic lower-time bound, not total inference time.
conventions.draft_rows: DFlash block 8 has 7 parallel query rows; block 4 has 3. Fixed drafter block does not shrink with adaptive target verification. MTP proposes k sequential rows. N-gram has zero neural drafter work.
conventions.aggregate: Sequential operation costs are summed as operations/capacity for each actual arithmetic path, then divided by emitted tokens.
